| Subcommand | What it does |
|---|---|
| `open` | file a finding, or touch/reopen the existing issue |
| `defer` | withhold an issue from `next` and `claim` until a date, or clear that |
| `block` | withhold an issue from `next` and `claim` until other issues close, or clear that |
| `manual` | reserve an issue for the operator, releasing any claim on it, or clear that |
| `touch` | record a re-observation; the third adds escalated |
| `comment` | post a plain comment: no label, no re-observation; a correction to an issue's body, say |
| `claim` | claim issues for a worktree |
| `release` | release this worktree's claim |
| `claims` | the stale claims and a count of the live ones |
| `reap` | release every stale claim |
| `close` | close as fixed, refuted or accepted |
| `list` | the open findings, for the review skill; marks manual, deferred and claimed issues rather than hiding any. Past findings are `history` |
| `history` | search findings in any state by topic or cited file; prints how each closed |
| `show` | one finding's body, outcome, closing PR and comment thread |
| `export` | write every finding in every state to one JSON file, for the break-glass kit |
| `sync-labels` | create any missing label |
| `verify` | print each finding's stored instructions for how to verify it; runs nothing |
| `next` | issues a session may pick up, best first |
